Sam (Support): noticing a cluster of customers hitting 429/503 and our python client retries seem to synchronize and spike DB connections. filing here before opening ticket.
Anya (Eng): can you paste a minimal repro + logs? are these async or sync clients?
Sam (Support): async, using python-sdk v0.14.2 with aiohttp. quick repro below that reliably shows identical backoff/jitter across workers -> simultaneous retries. also seeing idempotency header sometimes missing on retry.
Sam (Support): ```python
# repro: run this in multiple processes (gunicorn workers)
import asyncio
from redwood import AsyncClient

client = AsyncClient()

async def send():
    for i in range(3):
        await client.generate("test prompt", idempotency_key=f"test-{i}")

asyncio.run(send())
```
Sam (Support): logs (trimmed):
```
[2026-05-10T14:03:12Z] INFO request id=abc123 attempt=1 sleep_ms=200
[2026-05-10T14:03:12Z] INFO request id=def456 attempt=1 sleep_ms=200
[2026-05-10T14:03:12Z] INFO request id=ghi789 attempt=1 sleep_ms=200
[2026-05-10T14:03:13Z] INFO request id=abc123 retrying headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer **', 'Idempotency-Key': 'test-0'}
[2026-05-10T14:03:13Z] INFO request id=def456 retrying headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer **', 'Idempotency-Key': 'test-1'}
[2026-05-10T14:03:13Z] INFO request id=ghi789 retrying headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer **', 'Idempotency-Key': 'test-2'}
```
Sam (Support): but sometimes the retry log shows no Idempotency-Key for a request (we have a customer that saw duplicate charges because retries repeated a non-idempotent endpoint).
Lee (Eng Runtime): initial hypothesis: RNG seed copied at fork time (gunicorn pre-fork). deterministic jitter will be identical across workers if RNG seeded pre-fork. which jitter source does sdk use? random.random?
Sam (Support): looks like the SDK falls back to python's random if secrets isn't available. in our env random seed appears identical across workers (we saw same sequence).
Anya (Eng): that would explain correlated retries -> thundering herd. also need to repro header drop. can you capture full request/response for a failing run (with headers) and paste the sequence for the specific request that lost idempotency header?
Sam (Support): here's an extract where it drops:
```
-> POST /v1/generate headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer **', 'Idempotency-Key': 'cust-xyz', 'Content-Type':'application/json'} body=...
<- 503 Service Unavailable
retrying attempt=2 building new request from original req_obj
-> POST /v1/generate headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer **', 'Content-Type':'application/json'} body=...
<- 200 OK
```
Sam (Support): note: Idempotency-Key missing on the retried request above. i think our retry code rebuilds the request and doesn't copy some per-request headers when the body is a streaming or aiohttp payload.
Matt (Infra): also check connection reuse / session middleware. aiohttp payloads can only be streamed once; some SDKs replace body with a new stream wrapper and forget to attach headers.
Anya (Eng): OK two separate but related bugs: (1) deterministic jitter due to RNG seed duplication across forked workers and (2) idempotency header not preserved on retries when request body is a reusable stream wrapper.
Infra-Bot: Support ticket #78912 created and linked to this thread.
Anya (Eng): short-term mitigations: (a) patch SDK to use secrets.randbelow or os.urandom-backed jitter, and reseed after fork if process was forked (b) ensure we clone and preserve headers explicitly when rebuilding request for retry, don't rely on shallow copy of request object.
Lee (Eng Runtime): for (a) adding a call to os.getpid()-based reseed at client creation is brittle. prefer switching jitter RNG to use secrets or SystemRandom which is fork-safe since it draws from OS entropy. and add explicit test: spawn 4 processes, assert sleep_ms differ.
Anya (Eng): assigned to eng-runtime, PR will include unit+integration repro harness using multiprocessing to reproduce correlation. PR owner: @Anya (Eng). ETA EOD tomorrow.
Sam (Support): for customers we can recommend as workaround: restart workers after deploy (ensures RNG reseeded) and pin to 0.14.3-beta where we will publish quick fix. also ask them to enable request id logging so we can detect duplicates.
Matt (Infra): going to audit other SDKs for similar pattern (go/ts). creating infra ticket.
Sam (Support): for the idempotency header loss, customer affected org has been refunded and billing ticket opened. we need hotfix for header preservation ASAP.
Anya (Eng): I'll do a small hotfix branch that ensures headers are deep-copied and request body resetters are used. will add test that simulates aiohttp payload and retries.
Support-Bot: escalation update: related to #78912 -> severity=high, customers impacted=2, billing=true.
Lee (Eng Runtime): follow-ups: add e2e in CI that forks workers and runs the jitter variability check, and add a regression alert for duplicate non-idempotent requests observed by console telemetry.
Sam (Support): thanks everyone. I'll post customer-facing note once PRs are merged. :thumbsup:
Anya (Eng): opening draft PR now -> link will be posted in thread when ready.
Matt (Infra): leaving review once PR is up. also will validate with one of affected customers in staging.
Sam (Support): marking action items: 1) hotfix for header-preserve on retry (Anya) 2) RNG change to SystemRandom + fork-resilience tests (Anya/Lee) 3) infra audit other SDKs (Matt) 4) customer communication + refund (Sam).
Anya (Eng): noted. closing local triage, will update thread with PR and release notes. :white_check_mark:
